title: Normal × Banyan Sapling
tagline: Checking an AI diagnosis against the merchant's policy before any money is spent.

scenes.label: THE QUESTION
scenes.narration: Normal runs an online shop's operations with AI agents. Before any of those agents spend money, we check the AI's reasoning with Mubit's Banyan Sapling.
scenes.caption: What if the AI gets the diagnosis wrong?

scenes.label: AGENTS THAT ACT
scenes.narration: When sales drop, Normal works out why. Then its agents act on that diagnosis. They change ad budgets, email customers, and update the store.
scenes.caption: Diagnosis → plan → merchant approval → agent action

scenes.label: THE POLICY GATE
scenes.narration: That means everything depends on the diagnosis being right. So before a plan is built, we send Sapling three things. The merchant's policy, the evidence the AI cited, and the AI's claim. Sapling's verdict decides whether a plan can be built at all.
scenes.caption: Merchant policy + cited evidence + AI claim → Sapling verdict

scenes.label: SUPPORTED RUN
scenes.narration: Here's a live run. Fourteen orders missed their delivery promise, and the policy needs at least ten. Sapling says the claim is supported, so the plan goes to the merchant for approval.
scenes.caption: 14 late orders · at least 10 required · supported

scenes.label: BLOCKED RUN
scenes.narration: Now the same incident with only eight late orders. Same policy, same diagnosis. This time Sapling returns a violation, so the plan is blocked and the button is disabled. Nothing gets spent.
scenes.caption: 8 late orders · below the threshold · plan blocked

scenes.label: FOUR LIVE CHECKS
scenes.narration: We also run four fixed test cases against the same policy. Enough late orders is supported. Too few is a violation. Ad data with no delivery records is insufficient information. And two reports that contradict each other come back as inconsistent context.
scenes.caption: Supported · violation · insufficient information · inconsistent context

scenes.label: EVIDENCE BEFORE ACTION
scenes.narration: The server runs the check again when a plan is requested, so a client can't skip it. And the merchant still approves every plan that passes. That's Normal, with Banyan Sapling.
scenes.caption: Evidence first. Policy checked. Human approved.
